description: A heavier single-use FPV quad carrying twice the charge. Launch it and stand still at its tablet: you fly it in first person (movement keys; up to 55 m away) until it hits something or you detonate it (Space or its key again). The blast hurts every hostile within 4.5 m (75 at the centre, less at the edge; elites and bosses shrug off most of it). The drone is spent. Draws 1 energy a second while it flies, 45 seconds at most. Relay Nine stock; Rask sells it in Dustline.
